title_candidates: OpenAI proposes measuring useful work instead of AI activity
summary: OpenAI's proposed AI scorecard focuses on successful work, full task cost, reliability, and value at scale rather than seats or token prices.

primary_source.title: A scorecard for the AI age
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI proposes measuring useful work completed per dollar instead of adoption or token price alone.
The scorecard asks about work completed, full successful-task cost, reliability, and value as usage scales.
The full cost includes retries, human review, and correction rather than only model price.

steps.instruction: Define a successful outcome for one repeated task.
Run three trials and record cost, time, retries, corrections, and success.
Compare cost and time per successful output with the previous process.

references.title: A scorecard for the AI age
references.author: OpenAI

risk_flags: The framework is proposed by an AI vendor and should be applied with independent success criteria.
